bth_shaving_kit.name: Shaving brush and razor stand
bth_shaving_kit.flavor: A badger brush older than the man using it.

bth_bath_toys.name: Bath toys in a net
bth_bath_toys.flavor: A boat, a whale and a sponge of uncertain origin.

bth_shower_stool.name: Shower stool
bth_shower_stool.flavor: Teak, slatted and slowly going grey.

bth_potty.name: Potty
bth_potty.flavor: Celebrated loudly, once. Since retired with honours.

bth_child_step.name: Children's step
bth_child_step.flavor: So small hands can reach the tap and soak the floor.

bth_baby_bath.name: Baby bath
bth_baby_bath.flavor: Used for six months, kept for sixteen years.

bth_toothbrush_charger.name: Electric toothbrush on charger
bth_toothbrush_charger.flavor: Two minutes, buzzing, then a sulky pulse.

bth_water_flosser.name: Water flosser
bth_water_flosser.flavor: Sprays the mirror more than the teeth.

bth_hair_straighteners.name: Hair straighteners
bth_hair_straighteners.flavor: Left on, said nobody, while driving away.

bth_makeup_bag.name: Makeup bag
bth_makeup_bag.flavor: A lipstick from 2009 lives in the lining.

bth_shaving_mirror.name: Shaving mirror on a stand
bth_shaving_mirror.flavor: Magnifies each pore with grim enthusiasm.

bth_plunger.name: Plunger
bth_plunger.flavor: Owned by every house, admitted to by none.

bth_toilet_brush.name: Toilet brush in a pot
bth_toilet_brush.flavor: Avoided by eye, and by everyone.

bth_bath_bombs.name: Bowl of bath bombs
bth_bath_bombs.flavor: Fizzing glitter that the plughole will remember.

bth_nail_kit.name: Manicure set
bth_nail_kit.flavor: Every tool, and nobody knows what two of them do.

bth_pill_organiser.name: Weekly pill organiser
bth_pill_organiser.flavor: Tuesday is empty, but was it taken.

bth_foot_spa.name: Foot spa
bth_foot_spa.flavor: Bubbling beautifully at nobody since Christmas.

bth_linen_cupboard.name: Linen cupboard
bth_linen_cupboard.flavor: Sheets folded by one person, ruined by the rest.

bth_cleaning_caddy.name: Cleaning caddy
bth_cleaning_caddy.flavor: Bleach, cloths and a sponge best not asked about.

bth_mop_bucket.name: Mop and bucket
bth_mop_bucket.flavor: The mop gets washed less than the floor.

bth_cork_stool.name: Cork stool
bth_cork_stool.flavor: Warm to sit on, smells faintly of wine.

bth_mouthwash.name: Mouthwash and cups
bth_mouthwash.flavor: Burns like a punishment, minty as a promise.

bth_shower_radio.name: Shower radio
bth_shower_radio.flavor: Plays the news through a fog of steam.

bth_loo_roll_stand.name: Toilet roll stand
bth_loo_roll_stand.flavor: Holds four rolls and, often, none.

bth_reed_diffuser.name: Reed diffuser
bth_reed_diffuser.flavor: Smells of sea breeze, in a room with no window.

bth_hairbrush_comb.name: Hairbrush and comb
bth_hairbrush_comb.flavor: Full of hair. Whose, nobody will say.

bth_laundry_sorter.name: Three-bag laundry sorter
bth_laundry_sorter.flavor: Whites, darks, and a third bag of mysteries.

bth_box_of_tiles.name: Box of spare tiles
bth_box_of_tiles.flavor: Kept since 1998 in case one ever cracks.

bth_toilet_frame.name: Toilet safety frame
bth_toilet_frame.flavor: Borrowed from the hospital and never returned.

bth_bath_board.name: Bath board
bth_bath_board.flavor: Spans the bath like a tiny bridge for soap.

bth_wash_bag.name: Wash bag
bth_wash_bag.flavor: Packed for a weekend, unpacked in a fortnight.

bth_heated_rollers.name: Heated rollers
bth_heated_rollers.flavor: A sixties beehive, waiting in a plastic case.

bth_electric_shaver.name: Electric shaver on its stand
bth_electric_shaver.flavor: Rotary heads, and a beard it never quite finishes.

bth_talc_tin.name: Tin of talc
bth_talc_tin.flavor: Pre-war lavender, and a cloud with every shake.

bth_back_brush.name: Long-handled back brush
bth_back_brush.flavor: Reaches the bit between the shoulders. Victory.

bth_shower_curtain.name: Folded shower curtain
bth_shower_curtain.flavor: New, unopened, for the one gone mouldy.

bth_spare_shower_head.name: Boxed shower head
bth_spare_shower_head.flavor: Rainforest setting. The pressure says drizzle.

bth_snorkel_set.name: Mask and snorkel
bth_snorkel_set.flavor: Tested in the bath, saved for a holiday.

bth_bubble_bath_trio.name: Bubble bath bottles
bth_bubble_bath_trio.flavor: Gift set. Unopened. Re-gifted next year.

bth_lighthouse.name: Lighthouse ornament
bth_lighthouse.flavor: A seaside souvenir that faces the wrong way.

bth_laundry_powder.name: Box of washing powder
bth_laundry_powder.flavor: Big box, little scoop, lost scoop.

bth_bath_pillow.name: Bath pillow
bth_bath_pillow.flavor: Suckers that let go at the best moment.

bth_drawer_unit.name: Rolling bathroom drawers
bth_drawer_unit.flavor: Three drawers of plasters and old hair bands.

bth_seashell_dish.name: Seashell dish
bth_seashell_dish.flavor: Holds earrings, a ring and a mystery screw.

bth_loofah_hook.name: Loofah on a hook
bth_loofah_hook.flavor: Dried to a crisp, then soaked, forever.

bth_extractor_fan.name: Extractor fan
bth_extractor_fan.flavor: Whirrs for twenty minutes after you leave.

bth_sponge_net.name: Hanging sponge net
bth_sponge_net.flavor: Sponges in a net, smelling quietly of pond.

bth_squeegee.name: Shower squeegee
bth_squeegee.flavor: Bought in a burst of zeal, used twice.

bth_towel_ring.name: Towel ring with hand towel
bth_towel_ring.flavor: The hand towel nobody dries their hands on.

bth_hanging_plant.name: Hanging spider plant
bth_hanging_plant.flavor: Thrives on steam, ignores all advice.

bth_over_door_hooks.name: Over-door hooks
bth_over_door_hooks.flavor: Holds four towels. Nine are hung on it.

bth_grab_rail.name: Grab rail
bth_grab_rail.flavor: Fitted after the incident. Nobody mentions the incident.

bth_nail_varnish_rack.name: Nail varnish rack
bth_nail_varnish_rack.flavor: Forty shades of red and one green mistake.

bth_wall_boiler.name: Combi boiler
bth_wall_boiler.flavor: Hums, clicks, and goes out on Christmas Eve.

bth_pocket_organiser.name: Hanging pocket organiser
bth_pocket_organiser.flavor: A pocket for everything, and everything elsewhere.

bth_shower_timer.name: Shower timer
bth_shower_timer.flavor: Four minutes of sand, ignored at minute two.

bth_vanity_unit.name: Vanity basin unit
bth_vanity_unit.flavor: A basin on a cupboard full of half-used bottles.

bth_shower_tray.name: Boxed shower tray
bth_shower_tray.flavor: Bought for the refit, now propping up the refit.

bth_hot_water_tank.name: Lagged hot water cylinder
bth_hot_water_tank.flavor: Wrapped in a red jacket like a nervous swimmer.

bth_denture_pot.name: Denture pot
bth_denture_pot.flavor: Smiles at you from the shelf at night.

bth_bath_salts.name: Jar of bath salts
bth_bath_salts.flavor: Dead Sea, apparently. Bought in a lay-by.

bth_contact_lens_kit.name: Contact lens kit
bth_contact_lens_kit.flavor: Solution, case and a lens lost somewhere in the sink.

bth_pumice_dish.name: Pumice stone on a dish
bth_pumice_dish.flavor: For the heels. The heels are winning.

bth_shower_riser.name: Shower riser rail
bth_shower_riser.flavor: Slides up for one, down for the other, every time.

bth_roller_blind.name: Roller blind
bth_roller_blind.flavor: Stuck halfway, at exactly the wrong height.
